subject: prd/worker-transcript-metrics
statement: If If a harness exposes a figure as zero and that zero was never measured, then the system shall record it as an unavailability rather than as a zero
fit_criterion: two cases are distinguished and both tested: a transcript carrying an all-zero block **with no measurement having occurred** yields an unavailability; a transcript carrying a **legitimately measured zero** (an operation that genuinely consumed none of that quantity) yields the value zero. A rule that mapped every zero to unavailability would destroy real measurements, and one that mapped none would restore the silent zero
